functions.notes: Allocates Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_4 /*=4*/, 0x20) container holding 4 entries of {void *buf; void *secondary at +0x10}. Loop i=0..3 with u8 counter (lsl/lsr #0x18 narrowing on increment -> u8 i). After storing &ov01_02209B70[i*0xF000] it RELOADS the stored slot and NULL-checks it (always-true check on a bss address) -> write C as 'ret->buf[i] = ...; if (ret->buf[i] == NULL) return NULL;'. Then calls ov01_021FACF8(i, 0xF000, allocSecondary ? 0x9000 : 0, ret). Returns container ptr or NULL on alloc failure. Constants 0xF000 built as 0xF<<12 and 0x9000 as 9<<12 (immediate shifts, not pool). Sizes passed via locals r2 set in both branches -> u32 local 'size2'. Caller does 'str r0,[r4]' so result lives at offset 0 of the ov01_021F4704 manager struct.

risks: static helper ov01_021FACF8 is last in file but called by first function - forward declaration required, do not reorder definitions

always-true NULL check on &ov01_02209B70[i*0xF000] in ov01_021FAC44: must write the store-then-reload-then-compare through the struct slot to reproduce the str/ldr pair; folding it to a local pointer will drop the reload
large .bss symbol (0x3C000 bytes) - it is NOT in .public, so static; verify it lands in overlay 1 bss with exact size 4*0xF000
ov01_021FAC44.s includes msgdata headers (msg_0096/msg_0066) and many constants headers in the .inc preamble - likely boilerplate, no rodata in file so safe to omit
u8 loop counters (lsl #0x18/lsr #0x18 narrowing) in ov01_021FAC44 and ov01_021FACB4 vs un-narrowed u32 index params in the getters/helper - mixing these up flips instruction count
all exports only called from asm/overlay_01_021F4704.s (still asm) - prototypes go in a new include/overlay_01_021FAC44.h plus asm .inc untouched; no existing C callers to conflict with
notes: Tiny self-contained overlay-1 buffer-manager: constructor (ov01_021FAC44), destructor (ov01_021FACB4), two getters (ov01_021FACE4/EC), and a static clear helper (ov01_021FACF8) over a 4-slot {bss buffer 0xF000, optional heap buffer 0x9000} pool backed by bss array ov01_02209B70. Heap ID 4 hardcoded in constructor; check enum HeapID value 4 name in include/heap.h before using the enum constant. No rodata, no jump tables, no save_arrays involvement. Good easy decomp target.
